tools.name: calculate_four_pillars
tools.description: Compute a Japanese Four Pillars of Destiny (Shichu Suimei / BaZi) natal chart from Gregorian birth date, gender, and optional birth time and birthplace coordinates. Returns Year/Month/Day/Hour pillars, Heavenly Stems & Earthly Branches (天干・地支), Ten Gods (通変星), Twelve Life Stages (十二運星), Hidden Stems

tools.name: calculate_compatibility
tools.description: Compute Japanese Four Pillars (Shichu Suimei / BaZi) compatibility between two people from their Gregorian birth dates and optional birth times. Returns Day Stem relation (干合・相生・比和・相剋), Day & Month Branch relations (支合・半会・冲・刑・害・破), mutual Ten Gods (通変星), complementary Five Elements (五行), and shared
